title: Fractera Vectors — search by meaning for your node
description: Vector storage of the node: elements keep pieces of text as vectors and find the ones closest to a question. Programs reach it with the node key.

blocks.title: Search by meaning
blocks.description: Elements keep pieces of text here as vectors and find the ones closest to a question. Programs talk to it with the node key.

items: Collections keep the texts of one task apart from another
Vectors made with the node's OpenAI key, or ready vectors you bring

blocks.text: Send a text with the name of its collection. The element turns it into a vector with the node's OpenAI key, or takes the vector you send.
Ask a question and get the closest texts with a score. The index looks only at the requested collection, so a search stays fast as the store grows.
One door tells which model and size the store uses, how many records it holds and whether the index works.
Elements still call /vectors on the database element, and the database element passes the request here.
